subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader PR be the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95109 instead of the narrower Tavily-only https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110?
rationale: Both branches repair the Tavily credential fallback, but this PR additionally changes the shared agent Tool Search runtime-config boundary; choosing whether those changes land together is an ownership and merge-scope decision.

options.title: Land the broader guarded fix
options.body: Refresh this branch on current main, require the exact-head type gate to pass, then merge it and retire the narrower overlapping candidates.

options.title: Split the runtime repair
options.body: Land the Tavily-only fix separately and request the shared Tool Search snapshot helper and tests as a focused follow-up PR.

options.title: Use the narrower candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR in favor of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 only if maintainers do not want the agent Tool Search repair in the same landing.

recommendation.title: Land the broader guarded fix
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch on current main, require the exact-head type gate to pass, then merge it and retire the narrower overlapping candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and maintainer-authored force-push make steipete the clearest available owner for selecting and landing the canonical branch.
